units.title: The actual Gaussian Hermite class
units.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. For each natural degree \(j\) and ambient vector \(w\), define the actual Gaussian \(L^2\) class of \(H_j(\langle w,\cdot\rangle)\). Here \(H_j\) is the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial. Its integer coefficients are mapped canonically to the reals, and the proved polynomial membership witness forms the quotient class.
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(j\in\mathbb N\) and \(w\in E\) are arbitrary. This defines a class; pointwise values of its chosen representative are not specified.

steps.title: Read the literal class construction
steps.text: The polynomial smoothness theorem supplies membership for the real image of \(H_j\). Apply its membership witness at \(w\) to form the actual class of the literal ridge.
steps.lean:
noncomputable def gaussianHermiteRidgeL2 (j : ℕ) (w : E) : Lp ℝ 2 (stdGaussian E) :=
  let p := (hermite j).map (algebraMap ℤ ℝ)
  (Classical.choose
    (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.Probability.GaussianPolynomialRidgeSmooth.standard_gaussian_polynomial_ridge_L2_smooth (E := E) p) w).toLp
      (fun x : E => p.eval ⟪w,x⟫_ℝ)
